sec: Uric acid nephropathy: treatment & prevention · p802

items.q: Match the treatment of uric acid nephropathy — 1) Drug  2) Renal replacement … A) Dialysis  B) IV Rasburicase
items.exp: Treatment of uric acid nephropathy: (1) IV rasburicase, (2) dialysis. (Book p802)

items.q: The IV drug used to treat uric acid nephropathy is:
items.exp: Treatment: IV rasburicase along with dialysis; allopurinol appears under prevention (prophylaxis before chemotherapy). (Book p802)

items.q: The hydration advised before chemotherapy to prevent uric acid nephropathy is:
items.exp: Prevention: adequate hydration (5–6 L/day) before chemotherapy, adequate alkalinization and allopurinol. (Book p802)

items.q: Match the three preventive measures for uric acid nephropathy — 1) Hydration (5–6 L/day)  2) Alkalinization  3) Allopurinol … A) All three are preventive measures before chemotherapy
opts: All three are preventive measures before chemotherapy
Only hydration prevents tumour lysis syndrome
All three are treatments given after AKI is established
items.exp: Prevention of uric acid nephropathy: adequate hydration 5–6 L/day before chemotherapy, adequate alkalinization and allopurinol. (Book p802)

items.q: All but one of the following are preventive measures against uric acid nephropathy before chemotherapy. Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Rasburicase is the IV treatment of established uric acid nephropathy; prevention consists of hydration 5–6 L/day, alkalinization and allopurinol. (Book p802)

items.q: Allopurinol is listed under prevention of uric acid nephropathy rather than as the treatment of established disease.
opts: False — allopurinol is the treatment of established disease
False — allopurinol is used only for gout
items.exp: Prevention before chemotherapy: hydration 5–6 L/day, alkalinization and allopurinol; established disease is treated with IV rasburicase and dialysis. (Book p802)
